title: Food Delivery & Takeout UX Benchmark: 3,100+ Performance Scores and 1,900+ Best Practice Examples
description: This comprehensive benchmark analyzes over 3,100 performance scores across food delivery and takeout platforms, providing designers with data-driven best practices and actionable insights. Essential reference material for anyone designing e-commerce or on-demand experiences.

title: We're gorging on borrowed trust and it's going to cost us.
description: A critical examination of how brands exploit user trust in AI-powered products without mechanisms to prevent or acknowledge errors. This essay challenges designers to question the assumptions behind trusted interfaces and consider the hidden costs of unaccountable automation.

title: Everyone is designing with AI, not for it
description: A thought-provoking piece on how designers are using AI as a tool rather than fundamentally reconsidering what products should exist in an AI-first world. Highlights the gap between current design practice and the paradigm shift AI demands.

title: Let your designs fail for the right reasons
description: Mozilla's exploration of how AI-assisted native prototypes are transforming usability testing methodology and revealing new design insights. A practical guide to leveraging AI for better product validation.

title: State of AI in Design Systems
description: A field study examining how leading open-source design systems and platforms are making themselves intelligible to AI agents, offering insights into the future of design system architecture and accessibility. Critical for teams building scalable design infrastructure.

title: What a dollhouse full of death taught me about thinking
description: A creative, philosophical exploration of how physical models and systems thinking shape perception and decision-making. Offers profound insights on design methodology and the power of tangible representations in understanding complex problems.

title: Design's dreaded phrase is coming back. This time we're in control.
description: An optimistic take on democratizing design through AI and no-code tools, exploring how designers can maintain agency and purpose when design skills become more accessible. Reframes a controversial debate around the profession's evolution.

title: 11 Best Workflow Tools Freelancers and Agencies Actively Use in 2026
description: A practical roundup of the most effective workflow and productivity tools currently adopted by professional designers and agencies. Useful for optimizing team processes and staying current with industry-standard tooling.
